root_cause: An incomplete management-plane snapshot and status-substring matching could imply that security had been verified without all independent GitHub, Supabase, Netlify, and Website controls. The first protected candidate also omitted mandatory release metadata; a novel test path was not delivery-classified; then the material integration closure required append-only ledger and machine learning.

controls: Treat missing, stale, negated, expired and unverified security observations as not green.
Every platform requires all named controls with source readback and nonempty evidence, expiring on a bounded timescale.
Use absolute HTTPS-only href validation for provider-supplied evidence.
Use existing agent-security, ONE BRAIN, Heartbeat and exclusive protected writer; no second scheduler or customer-data truth store.
Always preflight obligation metadata and keep tests under a classified existing delivery owner.
Material code changes require a Brain learning object, append-only development event and human-facing change note.
Do not claim production deployment or autonomous external source polling until independently verified.

evidence.source: provider security advisor and existing private Security Trust observation register
